LESSON 38 / ADDITIONAL INTERVIEW CONCEPT
Progress and meter elements

Progress represents task completion. Meter represents a scalar measurement within a known range,
not progress toward finishing a task.
progress element එJකෙන් task completion Jපෙන්වනවා. meter එJකෙන් range එකෙකේ ඇතුJළේ measurement එකෙකේ Jපෙන්වනවා. Jදෙකෙ එකෙම Jදේ JනJවයි.
A dashboard displays upload completion and disk usage.
Upload progress · 60 / 100 · Disk usage meter · 80 / 100 GB · Progress = completion; meter = measurement

Read the diagram: The progress bar describes how much of an upload has finished. The meter
describes disk usage within a known capacity. Provide accessible labels.

<label>Upload <progress value="60" max="100">60%</progress></label>
<label>Disk <meter min="0" max="100" value="80">80 GB</meter></label>
Expected result: The upload shows 60% completion; the disk meter shows 80 of 100 units.
Interview question: When should you use meter instead of progress?
Answer: For a measurement within a known range, rather than task completion.
Practice: Display a 75% quiz completion bar.
